newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India has 10 Dubai crude offers in Feb tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: India has 10 Dubai crude offers in Feb tender - traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has received 10 offers of Dubai crude in its February tender, trade sources said on Friday.
India has tendered to buy a wide range of crudes, but typically takes Dubai, West African and Gulf of Suez grades.
Traders said the 10 Dubai crudes were offered mostly in a range of 63 cents to 72 cents above first-half quotes, although one major oil company offered a cargo at a premium of $1.00.
Details of Nigerian offers were still hazy, but Qua Iboe and Palanca were both offered on very large crude carriers (VLCCs). A major offered a combination VLCC of Qua Iboe and Palanca.
Traders said they believed a Gulf of Suez had also been offered.
In its January buying tender, India bought two Dubai cargoes at first-half month quotes plus 65 and 68 cents.
It also awarded three VLCCs of Qua Iboe between BQ plus 50 cents and 56.5 cents, delivered.
